propositions: The MCP and reconciler contract blocks re-call the shared composer with identical arguments instead of driving real entry points, making them trivially pass even if actual MCP or reconciler code stops routing through the composer.
The test must drive real MCP entry point (build_server + call_tool) and real reconciler argv entry point (rebar_reconciler.__main__.main --dry-run-enumerate) rather than re-composing.
Each surface block must fail with an explicit message when its corresponding entry point composes no operation snapshot, preventing false passes when instrumentation does not fire.

Each surface's composed snapshot must be anchored to absolute expected content (repo root, envelope version, config source provenance) distinct from the shared composer, not just compared across surfaces.
The shared input layer must move from CLI-only overrides to project and environment layers so MCP and reconciler surfaces can be asserted without accepting cli_overrides.
